While this Mini World Change is active, the {item:Energy Gate} in {wiki:Vengoth} opens and you can trade {item:Tentacle Piece|Tentacle Pieces} with the {npc:Dread Guardian} to fight alone against one of the incarnations of {creature:Devovorga}. Each boss you defeat gives you a **Slayer of ...** achievement and Bosstiary points.
The Mini World Change has to be active that day.
Enough {item:Tentacle Piece|Tentacle Pieces} for the boss you want to fight (see table).
Access to {wiki:Vengoth}: have started at least mission 4 (The Dark Lands) of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}, so that {npc:Harlow} takes you there.
2 to 16 per fight, depending on the boss
Being able to fight Devovorga's incarnations

With the Mini World Change active: enter the {item:Energy Gate} in Vengoth and trade {item:Tentacle Piece|Tentacle Pieces} with the {npc:Dread Guardian} for the boss you want (Anmothra, Chikhaton, Irahsae, Phrodomo or Teneshpar).
Only on days when the Mini World Change is active. You need access to {wiki:Vengoth} (mission 4 of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest|Blood Brothers Quest}).
Unlike the {wiki:Rise of Devovorga} event, here only **one person at a time** enters the teleport: you cannot kill the bosses as a team.
If your goal is {wiki:Bosstiary} points, focus on the three weakest bosses: {creature:Anmothra}, {creature:Irahsae} and {creature:Teneshpar} (75 Tentacle Pieces in total, according to the wiki).
{creature:Chikhaton} and {creature:Phrodomo} cost more pieces and are harder: depending on your level you may lose the pieces. It is easier to kill them as a team during the Rise of Devovorga event.

When the Mini World Change is active, one of these messages appears: *"In case you have some spare tentacle pieces, you can now use Devovorga's very essence to enter a boss lair!"* or *"Hear ye! Hear ye! Use Devovorga's Essence to fight an evil presence! Trade your every tentacle piece, to enter a boss' lair with ease!"*.

Take a boat to **Yalahar** (for example in Venore: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}). In Yalahar go to the docks of the **Trade Quarter** (straight **south** from the main gate) and talk to {npc:Harlow}: {key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes} (100 gp). He drops you off in the **west** of {wiki:Vengoth}; from there head **east** to the Energy Gate.
Harlow (arrival in the west of Vengoth)
Go to {wiki:Vengoth} and enter the {item:Energy Gate} at the indicated spot (it only works with the Mini World Change active).
There are {creature:Haunted Treeling|Haunted Treelings} in Vengoth.
Inside, talk to the {npc:Dread Guardian}. Say {key:hi}, {key:essence} and {key:yes}. Then say the **name of the boss** you want to fight; the pieces are deducted according to the table.
Enter the {item:Energy Gate} **south** of the Dread Guardian and kill the incarnation you chose. You get the corresponding achievement.
You go in alone: choose a boss suited to your level so you don't waste the pieces.

The wiki does not describe the way out of the lair: after the fight, go back the way you came to the Energy Gate ({coord:32949,31520,7}) and walk back **west** to {npc:Harlow}. Say {key:hi}, {key:yalahar} and {key:yes} (50 gp) to return to the docks of the Yalahar Trade Quarter.
